title: Patch: drop the web tests that pin a generated constant to its literal (audio, practice, emotes)
thread:
**Issue #2847 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #2847: Patch: drop the web tests that pin a generated constant to its literal (audio, practice, emotes)
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### Kind

Architecture

### Why

This is a sibling of #2846, the same cull applied to different files. It follows up #1125, whose PR #1140 removed only the tautological tests.

An `expect(CONST).toBe(<literal>)` repeats the number that CLAUDE.md rule 9 keeps in exactly one place. When the constant is generated (`apps/web/src/wire/engineConfig.ts`, `serverConfig.ts`, which CI diffs) or is already pinned by `apps/web/src/fx/constants.test.ts`'s S2 table, the line guards nothing.

### What to change

Handle exactly these lines in `apps/web/src`:

| File | Line |
|---|---|
| `audio/slam.test.ts` | `expect(SLAM_PITCH_SPREAD).toBe(0.05)` |
| `audio/musicDirector.test.ts` | `expect(LOW_HEALTH_AT).toBe(7)` |
| `audio/voice-lines.test.ts` | `expect(BANNED_WORDS_MAX_SHARE).toBe(0.02)` |
| `practice/config.test.ts` | `expect(PRACTICE_AI_CLOCK_MS).toBe(3000)` |
| `patches/ribbon.test.tsx` | `expect(NEW_RIBBON_PATCHES).toBe(2)` |
| `emotes/hand.test.ts` | `expect(EMOTE_HAND_SIZE).toBe(8)`, `expect(EMOTE_HAND_VOICE).toBe(3)` |
| `emotes/play.test.ts` | `expect(EMOTE_EMOJI_MS).toBe(2000)` |

Apply this rule to each line, and leave no case to judgment:

1. **Delete the line** if the constant is exported from `wire/engineConfig.ts` or `wire/serverConfig.ts`, or if it is a key in `fx/constants.test.ts`'s S2 table.
2. **Otherwise, keep the line.**
3. If an `it`/`test` is left with no assertion, delete it. If an import is left unused, delete it.

Out of scope: every other file. That includes `audio/cues.test.ts`, which belongs to the table-folding issue, and the `*_VERSION` pins (`deckCode`, `trioCode`, `tutorial/progress`, `replay/retcon-v05`), which stay as format tripwires.

### Acceptance

- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web` are green.
- Only the seven files above change.
- The PR lists each line, marked deleted or kept, with the rule that decided it.

### Blocked by, part of

None. Follows #1125; sibling of #2846.

### Difficulty (a guess)

easy: one app, seven files, a mechanical rule, checked by vitest.

### Priority

No priority

### Who does it

The night bot (bot:build)

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `claude-3` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/41494424013)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Apply the issue's three-part rule to the eight listed `expect(CONST).toBe(<literal>)` lines in `apps/web/src`. Only two of them meet rule 1. `EMOTE_HAND_SIZE` and `EMOTE_HAND_VOICE` are exported from `apps/web/src/wire/engineConfig.ts` (lines 56–57), so those two lines are deleted.

The other six constants each sit in their own hand-written module. None is in `wire/engineConfig.ts`, `wire/serverConfig.ts` or the S2 table of `apps/web/src/fx/constants.test.ts`, so their lines stay (rule 2). Done means:

- one test file is edited;
- the other six listed files are unchanged;
- typecheck, the unit tests and eslint are green;
- the PR body lists all eight lines, each marked deleted or kept, with the rule that decided it.

## Files to touch

| Path | new/change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/emotes/hand.test.ts` | change | Delete lines 44–45 (`expect(EMOTE_HAND_SIZE).toBe(8);` and `expect(EMOTE_HAND_VOICE).toBe(3);`) inside `it("R1341 holds EMOTE_HAND_VOICE voice lines and the rest emoji, EMOTE_HAND_SIZE distinct, in the pool's order", …)`. Nothing else. |

**Do not touch** these six files. Each keeps its line by rule 2:
- `apps/web/src/audio/slam.test.ts`
- `apps/web/src/audio/musicDirector.test.ts`
- `apps/web/src/audio/voice-lines.test.ts`
- `apps/web/src/practice/config.test.ts`
- `apps/web/src/patches/ribbon.test.tsx`
- `apps/web/src/emotes/play.test.ts`

Leave every other file alone too:
- every source file, and everything under `apps/web/src/wire/`;
- `apps/web/src/fx/`;
- `apps/web/src/audio/cues.test.ts` and the `*_VERSION` pins, which the issue puts out of scope;
- `spec/`, every crate and every other app.

**What governs it:** no spec section. CLAUDE.md rule 9 is why the change exists. Ruling R1341 (`spec/rulings/R1341.md`) lists `apps/web/src/emotes/hand.test.ts` in `proven_in`. The test's name, and its `R1341` token, stay as they are, so the note needs no edit and no R-id is added.

**Evidence** (from `grep -rn` of each name over `apps/web/src`; under `apps/web/src/wire/`, only the two `EMOTE_HAND_*` names appear):

| Test line | Constant defined at | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| `audio/slam.test.ts:55` `expect(SLAM_PITCH_SPREAD).toBe(0.05)` | `game/damageFeel.ts:110` | **kept**, rule 2 |
| `audio/musicDirector.test.ts:172` `expect(LOW_HEALTH_AT).toBe(7)` | `audio/musicDirector.ts:54` (`Math.floor(HERO_HEALTH * MUSIC_LOW_HEALTH_FRACTION)`; `LOW_HEALTH_AT` itself is not in `wire/`) | **kept**, rule 2 |
| `audio/voice-lines.test.ts:401` `expect(BANNED_WORDS_MAX_SHARE).toBe(0.02)` | `audio/constants.ts:90` | **kept**, rule 2 |
| `practice/config.test.ts:27` `expect(PRACTICE_AI_CLOCK_MS).toBe(3000)` | `practice/config.ts:36` | **kept**, rule 2 |
| `patches/ribbon.test.tsx:33` `expect(NEW_RIBBON_PATCHES).toBe(2)` | `patches/ribbon.ts:13` | **kept**, rule 2 |
| `emotes/hand.test.ts:44` `expect(EMOTE_HAND_SIZE).toBe(8)` | `wire/engineConfig.ts:56` (re-exported by `wire/emotes.ts:50`, reached as `@jackioh/shared` = `src/wire/index.ts`) | **deleted**, rule 1 |
| `emotes/hand.test.ts:45` `expect(EMOTE_HAND_VOICE).toBe(3)` | `wire/engineConfig.ts:57` (same re-export path) | **deleted**, rule 1 |
| `emotes/play.test.ts:149` `expect(EMOTE_EMOJI_MS).toBe(2000)` | `emotes/config.ts:6` | **kept**, rule 2 |

Rule 3 does not apply:
- The edited `it` keeps its assertions (lines 49–53 today: `toHaveLength(EMOTE_HAND_SIZE)`, the `Set` size, the voice count, the order check and `isEmoteHand`).
- Both constants stay in use in that `it`, so the import on line 8 stays unchanged.

## Steps

1. Open `apps/web/src/emotes/hand.test.ts`. Find `describe("R1341 the hand the engine deals, over WASM", …)` and inside it the `it` named `"R1341 holds EMOTE_HAND_VOICE voice lines and the rest emoji, EMOTE_HAND_SIZE distinct, in the pool's order"`. Delete exactly these two lines, its first two statements (44–45 today):
   ```ts
       expect(EMOTE_HAND_SIZE).toBe(8);
       expect(EMOTE_HAND_VOICE).toBe(3);
   ```
   The `it` body then starts with `for (const seed of SEEDS) {`. Do not touch:
   - the `it` title;
   - the import on line 8 (`EMOJI_EMOTE_IDS, EMOTE_HAND_SIZE, EMOTE_HAND_VOICE, EMOTE_IDS, VOICE_EMOTE_IDS, isVoiceEmote`);
   - any other line.
2. Check the change. `git diff --stat` must show only `apps/web/src/emotes/hand.test.ts` with 2 deletions. `git diff` must show exactly the two `-` lines above.
3. Write the PR body's line list from the evidence table above. List all eight lines, each marked **deleted** or **kept**, with the rule that decided it:
   - rule 1: exported from `wire/engineConfig.ts`;
   - rule 2: not in `wire/engineConfig.ts`, `wire/serverConfig.ts` or the S2 table.

   Also say:
   - rule 3 was checked: the `it` keeps five assertions and the import stays used;
   - the generated `wire/engineConfig.ts`, which CI diffs against `crates/engine/src/config.rs`, still pins 8 and 3, as do the R1341 note's text and the `toHaveLength(EMOTE_HAND_SIZE)` / `toHaveLength(EMOTE_HAND_VOICE)` assertions over 300 seeds.

## Tests

No new test. The existing tests must still pass:
- `apps/web/src/emotes/hand.test.ts`: every test still passes, in particular `"R1341 holds EMOTE_HAND_VOICE voice lines and the rest emoji, EMOTE_HAND_SIZE distinct, in the pool's order"`.

Commands, from the repository root:
- `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh` (once; `hand.test.ts` imports `@jackioh/engine`'s `dealEmoteHand`, which needs `apps/web/src/wasm/pkg`)
- `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/emotes/hand.test.ts`
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test`
- `pnpm exec eslint apps/web`
- `cargo jackioh spec check` (the file is in R1341's `proven_in`; it must stay green, which it does if the `it` titles are unchanged)

## Done when

- [ ] `apps/web/src/emotes/hand.test.ts` has lost exactly lines 44–45 (`EMOTE_HAND_SIZE` 8, `EMOTE_HAND_VOICE` 3). Its `it` title, its other assertions and its imports are unchanged.
- [ ] No other file changed (`git status` shows only `hand.test.ts`). The six files with kept lines are untouched.
- [ ] `vitest run src/emotes/hand.test.ts` passes.
- [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web` are green.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh spec check` is green.
- [ ] The harness checks pass: rustfmt, catalog, patches, rulings, clippy, cargo tests (with no diff under `apps/web/src/wire/`) and web tests.
- [ ] The PR body lists all eight lines with their verdict and rule, as in step 3.

## Risks

- **Scope creep.** The rule keeps six lines that a reader might want to delete, `LOW_HEALTH_AT` especially, since it is computed from the generated `HERO_HEALTH`. The issue's rule is mechanical: `LOW_HEALTH_AT` is not exported from `wire/`, so its line stays. Do not delete any kept line, and do not edit other `toBe(<literal>)` pins outside the table.
- **Reads as a weakened check.** A reviewer may see deleted assertions. The issue asks for this deletion. The values stay pinned in one place, the generated `wire/engineConfig.ts`, which CI regenerates and diffs. Say so in the PR body.
- **Spec check.** Renaming or deleting the R1341 `it` would break `cargo jackioh spec check`, because the file proves R1341. The plan deletes only two statements inside it.
- **No overlap with #2846.** The sibling changes `game/animations.flavor-damage.test.ts` and `game/animations.flavor.test.ts` only.
- No effect on determinism, replay, hidden information or any README contract: a test-only, two-line deletion.

## Open questions

None.
<!-- /jackioh-bot:plan -->
````
